WITH brightest_star AS (
    SELECT 
        stellarref,
        hostplname,
        (stellarprops->'photometry'->>'Opt_Mag')::float as opt_mag,
        (stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value')::float as mass_solar
    FROM stars 
    WHERE stellarprops->'photometry'->>'Opt_Mag' IS NOT NULL 
      AND stellarprops->'photometry'->>'Opt_Mag' != 'None'
    ORDER BY opt_mag ASC 
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    hostplname,
    opt_mag,
    mass_solar,
    ROUND(CAST(6.67430e-11 * (mass_solar * 1.989e30) AS numeric), 2) as gravitational_parameter
FROM brightest_star;
